definitions: The Japanese language as it has been spoken and written since the Meiji Restoration (1868), characterized by significant changes in vocabulary, grammar, and writing system compared to earlier forms.

A period in Japanese history and culture, generally considered to begin with the Meiji Restoration in 1868 and continue to the present day, marked by rapid modernization, Westernization, and significant social and political changes.
examples: She is studying Modern Japanese literature.
The grammar of Modern Japanese differs from Classical Japanese.
Many aspects of Modern Japanese culture reflect global influences.
